Paper Title: Four facts about ESG beliefs and investor portfolios
Key Contribution: Survey data mining on ESG investor beliefs and portfolio holdings correlation
Data Mining Techniques: Survey data analysis, behavioral pattern mining, correlation analysis
Project Potential Justification: Medium-high potential. Rich survey + administrative data with behavioral patterns. Could replicate with survey data, analyze ESG belief-portfolio correlations, and build predictive models for ESG investment behavior.

Paper Title: The price of sin: The effects of social norms on markets
Key Contribution: Empirical foundation showing social norms affect asset pricing through sin stocks
Data Mining Techniques: Cross-sectional analysis, institutional holdings analysis, return analysis
Project Potential Justification: Medium potential. Requires institutional holdings data and return data. Could extend by mining ESG ratings, institutional investor characteristics, and building classification models for norm-sensitive investors.

Paper Title: Persistent and transitory components of firm characteristics
Key Contribution: Decomposes firm characteristics into persistent/transitory components to improve return prediction
Data Mining Techniques: Time-series decomposition, cross-sectional prediction, anomaly detection
Project Potential Justification: High potential. Strong data mining angle - decomposing firm characteristics, feature engineering for prediction. Accessible via financial databases (CRSP, Compustat). Could build ML models predicting returns using decomposed features.

Paper Title: Common risk factors in the returns on stocks and bonds
Key Contribution: Three-factor model (market + size + value) foundation for cross-sectional return analysis
Data Mining Techniques: Factor analysis, portfolio construction, regression analysis
Project Potential Justification: Medium-high potential. Classic data mining project - construct factors from stock data, test cross-sectional predictions. Widely replicable with public data. Could extend with modern ML techniques or additional factors.

Paper Title: Asset life leverage and debt maturity matching
Key Contribution: Theory and evidence linking debt maturity to asset life cycles
Data Mining Techniques: Panel data analysis, regression modeling, duration analysis
Project Potential Justification: Medium potential. Requires firm-level data on assets and debt structure. More econometric than data mining focused. Could mine patterns in financing decisions but less algorithmic angle.

Paper Title: Determinants of corporate borrowing
Key Contribution: Underinvestment problem and maturity matching theory foundation
Data Mining Techniques: Theoretical model with empirical validation
Project Potential Justification: Lower potential. Primarily theoretical foundation. Limited data mining angle unless combined with large-scale empirical testing on modern datasets.

Paper Title: Harnessing the overconfidence of the crowd: A theory of SPACs
Key Contribution: Theoretical model explaining SPAC structure through investor overconfidence
Data Mining Techniques: Theoretical modeling with empirical validation, event study analysis
Project Potential Justification: Medium-high potential. Could mine SPAC announcement data, investor behavior, returns around key events. Rich event study opportunities with classification/prediction of SPAC outcomes.

Paper Title: Volume volatility price and profit when all traders are above average
Key Contribution: Foundation of overconfidence effects on trading volume and market outcomes
Data Mining Techniques: Trading pattern analysis, volume-return relationships
Project Potential Justification: Medium potential. Requires trading data (volume, volatility). Could mine retail trading patterns, classify overconfident traders, predict volume spikes. Data access may be challenging.

Paper Title: Fearing the Fed: How wall street reads main street
Key Contribution: Time-varying market sensitivity to macro announcements linked to monetary policy
Data Mining Techniques: Event study methodology, time-series analysis, decomposition methods
Project Potential Justification: High potential. Event-driven data mining - macro announcement effects on returns. Accessible macro data + market data. Could build ML models predicting market reactions to news/announcements by policy regime.

Paper Title: What explains the stock market's reaction to Federal Reserve policy?
Key Contribution: Quantifies market reaction to Fed policy surprises and decomposes channels
Data Mining Techniques: Event study, variance decomposition, regression analysis
Project Potential Justification: Medium-high potential. Fed policy surprise data available. Could extend with modern NLP on Fed communications, predict market reactions, classify policy regimes. Good replication + extension project.

Paper Title: Is it alpha or beta? Decomposing hedge fund returns
Key Contribution: New method for alpha/beta decomposition under model misspecification
Data Mining Techniques: Statistical decomposition, factor analysis, robustness testing
Project Potential Justification: Medium-high potential. Hedge fund return data from databases. Methodologically rigorous - implement decomposition algorithms, compare models, predict alpha vs beta sources. Strong statistical/ML angle.

Paper Title: The performance of mutual funds in the period 1945-1964
Key Contribution: Jensen's Alpha - risk-adjusted performance measurement foundation
Data Mining Techniques: Regression analysis, performance attribution
Project Potential Justification: Medium potential. Classic replication study. Modern mutual fund data widely available. Could extend with ML for predicting fund performance, clustering funds by strategy, feature importance analysis.

Paper Title: Financial returns to household inventory management
Key Contribution: Households earn returns on inventory management as an investment activity
Data Mining Techniques: Scanner data analysis, portfolio return calculation, household behavior modeling
Project Potential Justification: High potential. Unique angle - consumer behavior data mining. Scanner/transaction data could be obtained or simulated. Predict inventory strategies, optimize household portfolios, consumer segmentation. Novel application area.

Paper Title: Household finance
Key Contribution: Foundation establishing household finance as research field
Data Mining Techniques: Survey analysis, descriptive statistics, behavioral analysis
Project Potential Justification: Lower-medium potential. More conceptual/survey paper. Could mine household financial survey data (SCF) for patterns, but less algorithmic focus. Better as background for a household finance DM project.

Paper Title: Disclosing and cooling-off: An analysis of insider trading rules
Key Contribution: Analyzes impact of disclosure and cooling-off period regulations on insider trading
Data Mining Techniques: Equilibrium modeling, policy analysis, empirical testing
Project Potential Justification: Medium potential. Insider trading data available from SEC filings. Could mine disclosure patterns, predict trading outcomes, analyze regulation effectiveness. Requires careful data collection but interesting policy angle.

Paper Title: Continuous auctions and insider trading
Key Contribution: Foundation for information asymmetry and market microstructure theory
Data Mining Techniques: Theoretical modeling with equilibrium analysis
Project Potential Justification: Lower potential. Highly theoretical. Limited direct data mining application unless combined with modern market microstructure data (order book, HFT data) which is difficult to access.

Paper Title: Stealthy shorts: Informed liquidity supply
Key Contribution: Shows informed short sellers act as liquidity providers rather than demanders
Data Mining Techniques: Limit order book analysis, trading pattern classification, microstructure analysis
Project Potential Justification: Very high potential. Rich microstructure data mining - classify trading strategies, predict informed vs uninformed shorts, analyze order flow. Excellent ML/classification project if order-level data accessible.

Paper Title: Risk uncertainty and divergence of opinion
Key Contribution: Theory of how short-sale constraints and opinion divergence affect pricing
Data Mining Techniques: Theoretical framework
Project Potential Justification: Lower potential. Theoretical foundation. Could test empirically with short interest data + opinion proxies (analyst dispersion), but primarily a theory paper.

Paper Title: JEL: End-to-end neural entity linking at JPMorgan Chase
Key Contribution: Neural entity linking for financial news without Wikipedia dependency
Data Mining Techniques: Deep learning (Wide & Deep), entity embeddings, margin loss, string matching (n-gram similarity)
Project Potential Justification: Very high potential. Perfect data mining project - NLP + entity resolution. Can use financial news datasets, build entity linking models, compare string matching algorithms. Directly applicable with strong ML/DL component and clear evaluation.

Paper Title: Deep learning in economics: Systematic review and critique
Key Contribution: Comprehensive survey of DL applications in economics with 631 papers analyzed
Data Mining Techniques: Systematic literature review, bibliometric analysis, method categorization
Project Potential Justification: Lower potential as project. This is a review paper, not an original research with data. Could be excellent background reading but doesn't directly lead to a DM project implementation.

Paper Title: Deep learning for business analytics and operations research
Key Contribution: Evaluates DL value in business analytics with practical guidance
Data Mining Techniques: Literature review, case study analysis, architecture evaluation
Project Potential Justification: Lower potential as project. Another review paper. Provides guidance on when DL works but not an implementation study. Useful for understanding DL applicability but doesn't define a specific project.

Paper Title: Deep learning in business analytics: Conflicts between expectations and reality

Key Contribution: GNN-based prediction of code reverts using code dependency graphs
Data Mining Techniques: Graph Neural Networks, imbalanced classification, anomaly detection, code graph construction
